column1: # Dissociation-induced genes excluded from differential expression, GSEA and the classifier
# gene pool, at the same stage as the mitochondrial, ribosomal and haemoglobin genes
# (EXCLUDED_DISSOCIATION_GENES in scripts/00_config.R, which lists the exclude_names column).
# Source: van den Brink SC, Sage F, Vertesy A, Spanjaard B, Peterson-Maduro J, Baron CS,
#   Robin C, van Oudenaarden A. Single-cell sequencing reveals dissociation-induced gene
#   expression in tissue subpopulations. Nat Methods 14, 935-936 (2017). doi:10.1038/nmeth.4437.
#   Supplementary Table 5, "List of genes of which expression levels were assumed to be
#   affected by the dissociation procedure", in the Supplementary Text and Figures PDF
#   genes, which include all 32 genes of Supplementary Table 1.
# Human orthologs: MGI mouse-human homology report HOM_MouseHumanSequence.rpt, downloaded
#   52ded7aa493b5d9098a60635356bfae5). Mouse symbols renamed since 2017 were resolved with the
#   MGI marker list MRK_List2.rpt (same date, md5 59f8602314eb67bea69bd36aeb95e9f8):
#   Cyr61 -> Ccn1; Fam132b -> Erfe; Ccrn4l -> Noct.
#   One-to-many mappings, all kept: Cxcl1 -> CXCL1, CXCL2, CXCL3; H3f3b -> H3-3B, H3-5; Mt1 ->
#   MT1A, MT1B, MT1E, MT1F, MT1G, MT1H, MT1L, MT1M, MT1X; Rap1b -> RAP1B, RAP1BL; Hsp90aa1 ->
#   HSP90AA1, HSP90AA4P; Mt2 -> MT1X, MT2A; Hsp90ab1 -> HSP90AB1, HSP90AB3P.
#   154 human orthologs, 150 of them in the atlas; absent: HSP90AA4P, HSP90AB3P, MT1L, RAP1BL.
#   Atlas features named by an older HGNC symbol (unambiguous previous symbols only), also
# Added: HSPA6, a stress-inducible human HSP70 with no mouse ortholog (not in the MGI
#   homology report), so a mouse-derived list cannot contain it.
# Columns: human_symbol; mouse_symbol, the 2017 symbol in Supplementary Table 5;
#   exclude_names, the names excluded (the human symbol and any atlas name for it).
